mechanism: Task Scheduler logon task 'TB-Runtime-Supervisor' (current user, Interactive, limited privilege)
approval: explicit user approval granted for the exact schtasks command (request_elevation)
repoint_note: when the tb-forward-engine branch is relocated to a stable path (e.g. the user's main checkout), re-run quant-lab/runtime/install_windows_runtime.ps1 to repoint the task; uninstall via uninstall_windows_runtime.ps1

behavior.at_logon: supervisor starts; reads durable desired-state flag
behavior.after_tbctl_stop: task starts supervisor but worker stays stopped (STOPPED_BY_USER)
